description: Fork of exp638 (tiny hybrid_smooth baseline = 1.5835 @ 43.06M). Adopts 4 best practices: (1) MeanAbsNorm pre-norm at block start fed to qkv_lut and v_lut; (2) E-residual stream (x_lut_next = x_flat + out_e, identity skip around attention/LUT block); (3) MeanAbsNorm post-norm before residual_lut (replaces LayerNorm); (4) Lion optimizer for LUT params (was AdamW), lut_lr 1e-3 -> 2e-4, betas=(0.9, 0.95). Architecture, shapes, and step count unchanged. Reference: exp638 = 1.5835, exp615 = 1.5845, exp625 (n_alt=3 dense) = 1.5742, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
